statement: Let φ : V/B 99K V ′/B′ be an ordinary fourfold link over a two-dimensional common base Q. Put k = C(Q), and denote its generic end surfaces, with their induced Mori structures, by S and S′. If its restriction is the nontrivial two-ray move in Lemma 5.6(ii), then cu,hor/Q(φ) = w(S′ ) − w(S). (5.10) Every conic surface participating in such a move has at most seven singular geometric fibres. In the other case of Lemma 5.6, HQ = 0 without any bound on the discriminant size.
